text:
sara (People Ops): thought bubble 10 what about a 'Token Trove' micro-hunt for recognition tokens around HQ the week of the all-hands? quick, playful way to surface cross-team kudos + a physical token they can keep.

leo (Events): love the gamified angle. how would people know where to look? clues? map? digital hints? :eyes: 

maya (Office Ops): we can hide 30 tokens in common areas + 20 in meeting rooms. recommend low-profile locations only (not in safety or restricted areas). ops can coordinate packing and a discrete key for security.

jess (Finance): rough budget for tokens + small pouch + signage = $520. can we cap at $600 and include a small prize for the first 5 finders? maybe a $15 coffee voucher each.

oliver (Security): safety checklist: confirm no tokens in locked server rooms or on critical equipment. tokens should be soft material (felt or rubber) to avoid damage or misplacement risk. also mark them with an internal code so they can be returned if found in odd spots.

leo (Events): format idea: each token has a short prompt on the back like "Name one teammate who helped you this month" + a short QR to submit that shoutout. we collect entries and feature them during all-hands.

sara (People Ops): great. that creates immediate content for recognition. participants can either keep the token or return it to a dropbox for a chance at the small prize.

maya (Office Ops): logistics: need 2 volunteers for morning placement and 2 for evening sweep to ensure none are left overnight in risky places. I'll run a volunteer sheet.

jess (Finance): approve $600 from micro-events budget. please provide final PO and vendor.

leo (Events): vendor recs: tokenmfg.co does soft rubber tokens, 50 qty, $8/unit including 2-color imprint and small pouch. lead time 7 business days. sample request costs $25.

oliver (Security): please avoid adhesives that could mark desks. recommend small cloth pouch inside tokens to prevent residue. also log placement spots in a shared spreadsheet incase facilities need retrieval.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled  submit PO and volunteer signups by 2001237600.

sara (People Ops): draft copy for Slack announcement: "Find a Token Trove item this week and leave a shoutout! Keep the token or drop it back for a prize. Scan the QR to submit your message — we'll highlight favorites at the all-hands." feedback?

leo (Events): short and clear. add "follow safety signs" note for HQ.

maya (Office Ops): I'll create the placement spreadsheet and volunteer signup link. ops will run a short training note for volunteers about safe placement.

jess (Finance): jess here 10 once we have vendor quote, I'll route the PO. target: tokens in-hand 1 week before all-hands.

sara (People Ops): checklist: 1) order sample (leo) 2) finalize qty & PO (jess + leo) 3) placement plan + spreadsheet (maya) 4) announcement copy + QR landing page (sara). I'll update thread when PO is sent. excited :sparkles:
